description: This PHP file defines a command class 'LDAPSyncUserCommand' used for synchronizing LDAP users within the OrangeHRM system. It includes configuration, execution logic for LDAP sync, error handling, and interacts with LDAP-related services and models.

classes.name: LDAPSyncUserCommand
classes.description: Defines a console command for performing LDAP user synchronization, handling configuration checks, performing sync, and managing sync status with error handling.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command's name identifier used in CLI ('orangehrm:ldap-sync-user').

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description for CLI help/cues.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that performs LDAP synchronization, handles errors, and updates sync status.
